topic: GitHub Copilot code review limits — a refund pull request passes analyze, tests, the layering rule and an AI review Skill, and still refunds the wrong amount, because AI reviews how code is written, not whether it is the right code.

title.sub: AI reviews how code is written, not whether it is right.

stages.title: A refund pull request
stages.desc: A use case, a button and three tests. It goes up for review.
stages.narration: A pull request adds cancel and refund to a food delivery app.

stages.title: Every check is green
stages.desc: Analyze clean, tests passing, and the review Skill finds no blocking issues.
stages.narration: Analyze passes. Tests pass. The AI review finds nothing blocking.

stages.title: Three days later
stages.desc: Promo customers are refunded more than they paid.
stages.narration: Three days later, promo customers get back more than they paid.

stages.title: Why every gate missed it
stages.desc: The tests had no promo, so subtotal and total were the same number.
stages.status: tests without a promo: subtotal == total
stages.narration: The tests had no promo code, so both numbers matched.

stages.title: Two jobs in one review
stages.desc: Mechanical: is it written correctly? Judgment: is it the correct code?
stages.narration: Review is two jobs. Is it written correctly? Is it the correct code?

stages.title: What the Skill is good at
stages.desc: Rule-based, tireless, consistent: the checklist layer.
stages.status: logic in controller · missing test · secret in diff
stages.narration: AI is tireless on the checklist. Logic in controllers, missing tests, secrets.

stages.title: What only a person asks
stages.desc: "What did the customer pay?" and a test for a promo order.
stages.status: refund = order.total · test with a promo
stages.narration: A person asks what the customer paid, and adds a test with a promo.

stages.title: Never approve on green
stages.desc: CI blocks. The Skill advises. A human approves and owns the merge.
stages.status: CI: required · Skill: advisory · human: approves
stages.narration: CI blocks, the Skill advises, and a human approves.

stages.title: Automate the checklist
stages.desc: AI owns the mechanical layer. People own whether it is the right code.
stages.narration: Automate the checklist. Keep the judgment.

end.title: Automate the checklist. Keep the judgment.
end.sub: AI can review whether code is written well, not whether it is the right code.

post.caption:
A refund pull request passes everything. flutter analyze: clean. Tests: passing. AI review: 0 blocking issues. Merged. ⚖️

Three days later, promo customers are refunded more than they paid. The code refunded order.subtotal, the price of the dishes, instead of order.total, what the customer was charged.

The tests had no promo in them, so both numbers matched.

CODE REVIEW IS TWO JOBS
Mechanical: naming, tests, layer boundaries, secrets, contracts. Rule-based. Automate it.
Judgment: is this the right design, the right business rule, the right trade-off, and who owns it? Keep a person here.

THE SETUP
• CI blocks: analyze, tests, architecture greps
• A review Skill advises, with a capped, three-section output
• A named human approves every merge

Full write-up: blog.msdevbuild.com/blog/github-copilot-automate-code-review-limits
